title: Stein Kernelized Molecular Dynamics for Active Learning of Interatomic Potentials
abstract: arXiv:2606.04100v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Machine learning interatomic potentials (MLIPs) enable efficient and accurate atomistic simulations but depend critically on the quality and diversity of the training data. We introduce Stein kernelized molecular dynamics (SKMD), an enhanced sampling method that uses interacting particle dynamics to acquire informative training configurations for the fine-tuning of MLIPs. SKMD corresponds to a stochastic variant of Stein variational gradient descent that is adapted for molecular dynamics by incorporating asynchronous particle updates and a kernel of global atomic descriptors, which provides a symmetry-aware measure of configurational similarity. Unlike other enhanced samplers used in molecular dynamics, SKMD maintains the Boltzmann distribution as a stationary distribution of its dynamics in the appropriate asymptotic limit. translated_title: 用于原子间势主动学习的Stein核化分子动力学
translated_abstract: 机器学习原子间势（MLIP）能够实现高效且精确的原子尺度模拟，但其性能关键取决于训练数据的质量与多样性。我们提出了Stein核化分子动力学（SKMD），这是一种增强采样方法，利用相互作用粒子动力学来获取具有信息量的训练构型，用于MLIP的微调。SKMD对应于Stein变分梯度下降的一种随机化变体，通过引入异步粒子更新以及基于全局原子描述符的核函数而适配于分子动力学，该核函数提供了一种对称性感知的构型相似性度量。与分子动力学中使用的其他增强采样器不同，SKMD在适当的渐近极限下能够保持玻尔兹曼分布作为其动力学的平稳分布。这一特性在多样构型的探索与向高（概率区域的吸引）之间实现了平衡……
tldr: 提出了Stein核化分子动力学（SKMD），一种基于相互作用粒子动力学的增强采样方法，能主动获取多样且有信息量的训练构型用于微调机器学习原子间势，并在渐近极限下保持玻尔兹曼分布为平稳分布。
en_tdlr: SKMD is a Stein kernelized molecular dynamics enhanced sampling method that uses interacting particle dynamics to actively acquire diverse, informative training configurations for fine-tuning MLIPs, while preserving the Boltzmann distribution as a stationary distribution in the appropriate asymptotic limit.
